summary: Iter 21 — Lighting Upgrade Engine: full backend + frontend testing. All 12 pytest tests pass (catalog/proposal/portfolio/warranty/notify/stats). Frontend page loads cleanly, all required data-testids present, calculator email-gate validation works, proposal generation + approve API integration works end-to-end, regional rollup + warranty system render, homepage CTA visible, mobile 390x844 has zero horizontal overflow. Supermarket demo still loads (no regression).
critical_code_review_comments: lighting_engine.py is 450 lines and single-file; acceptable for now but could split into models/compute/router if it grows further.
Action ID alphabet correctly excludes I/O/0/1 (confirmed by regex test [A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]).
Subscription premium (12% blended) and 22% install estimate are hard-coded constants — fine for demo but flag if customer asks for tunability.

Approve button is inside a sticky-ish header strip; on small/mid scroll positions a force-click without scroll_into_view can miss it. Real users will scroll naturally so not user-impacting, but documented for future Playwright authors.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {"_id": 0} on all reads. Good.
test_credentials: none required (public endpoints; email-gate uses any valid email)
seed_data_creation: Tests create real proposals + warranty events + contractor notifications under TEST email cfo@example.com / test@example.com. Records are persisted in lighting_projects / lighting_warranty_events / lighting_contractor_notifications collections — no cleanup performed (acceptable for demo data; aligns with portfolio rollup which lists recent saves).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All /api/lighting/* endpoints proven via /app/backend/tests/test_lighting_engine.py. Frontend approve button requires scroll-into-view before clicking in Playwright (do NOT use force=True without scrolling — element is in a flex header that can sit at top of viewport with sticky nav on top). The calculator pre-fills every numeric field; only email + (optionally) contractor name need typing. Page testid is 'lighting-upgrade-engine-page'. The portfolio rollup is partially seeded (184 stores, 6 regions) so it is populated even on a fresh DB — verified.
rca of the issue: No production issues. One self-inflicted test issue: initial Playwright run used force=True click on approve-proposal-btn while the button was outside the viewport — the click landed but did not propagate to the React onClick handler in some browsers. Resolved by using scroll_into_view_if_needed() + plain click(). Backend POST /proposal/{id}/approve confirmed 200 + status flips to 'approved' both via API and via UI.
